entries.text: Round-1 code from contract.md (Registry#preceding, agents/ewoki-linker.md, evals) is NOT on HEAD; origin/kig/008.01-spec-ewoki-linker only carried spec/plan docs. Plan starts from zero.

blocked.md B1-B6: where linker runs (main vs worktree gate), [] vs [none] semantics, auto-merge vs UNGRANTABLE gh pr merge, what tsort adds over 008.00 gate, split into plans, system UI lane.
Folder lock .plans/008.01…/** is held by harness pid 36356 with intent naming palpatine-planner; alock acquire refused, wrote blocked.md under it as the harness's own invocation.
After answers: write plan.md. Reuse plan-prior-to-tsort.md U1-U7 shapes where still valid, add link command / pull guard / PR flow / tsort per B-answers.

B1 Where the linker runs Item 7 runs ewoki inside the run loop: a dispatcher gate in front of each 📋/⭐️ plan, in that plan's worktree. "When it runs" says the linker must run only in the primary repo, on `main`, never in a worktree, over the whole corpus, before the engine starts and after `create`/brief. Both can't hold. a) Primary repo only: the `link` command, plus a pre-pass `run` makes on `main` before the first round. Drop the per-plan dispatcher gate (item 7). (Recommended) b) Both: the …
entries.answer: Decided 2026-10-20 by the product owner: (a) primary repo only. The `link` command, plus a pre-pass `run` makes on `main` before the first round. Drop the per-plan dispatcher gate (item 7).

entries.text: B2 What "no dependencies" looks like, and whether `[]` gets re-checked Item 8 writes `[]` when there are none, and item 9 says a key that is already there, even `[]`, is never touched. "When it runs" says `[]` gets re-checked and the "none" case is written as the keyword `none` in brackets. If `[]` means "not linked yet", a human has no way to write "no dependencies, leave it alone". a) Write `depends_on: [none]` for "checked, none". Re-check a missing key and `[]`. Skip `[none]` and any non-em…
entries.answer: Decided 2026-10-20 by the product owner: (a) write `depends_on: [none]` for "checked, none". Re-check a missing key and `[]`; skip `[none]` and any non-empty list. `Spec#depends_on` reads `[none]` as no edges.

entries.text: B3 Auto-merging the linking PR "New links" means a branch `$USER/plan-linking-NNN.MM`, a pushed PR, and the dispatcher merging it once CI goes green. Today `gh pr merge` is in `UNGRANTABLE`, and CLAUDE.md says "Merging is not [grantable]. Keep that line where it is." The harness (not an agent) would be the one merging, but it would be the first automatic merge to `main` anywhere in openlanes. a) The harness opens the PR and stops. A human merges it. `link` prints the PR URL and `run` waits for …
entries.answer: Decided 2026-10-20 by the product owner: (b) the harness, never an agent, merges the linking PR on green CI through the `GitHub` seam, and only when its diff touches nothing but `depends_on:` lines in `.plans/*/spec.md`. `gh pr merge` stays in `UNGRANTABLE` for agents.

entries.text: B4 What topological sort adds to the existing gate 008.00 already holds a plan whose `depends_on:` names anything not yet ✅ (`Dispatcher` line ~1118, `Plans::Dependencies#waiting_on`). So "only the first plan in a DAG is worked on until it merges" already happens. What's left is order: which ready plans claim the `jobs` workers first. a) Order only: when `run` gets no plan arguments, sort the candidates by `TSort` over `Dependencies`, roots of each disjoint DAG first, ordinal as the tie-break. …
entries.answer: Decided 2026-10-20 by the product owner: (a) order only. With no plan arguments, `run` sorts candidates by `TSort` over `Dependencies`, roots of each disjoint DAG first, ordinal as the tie-break. Holding stays with the 008.00 gate.

entries.text: B5 Split into plans Items 6–9 plus `link`, the main-branch guard and `git pull`, the branch/PR flow, the run pre-pass and tsort come to about twelve units. That's more than one reviewable pull request. a) Two plans. 008.01: the agent, `Registry#preceding`, executor grants, the `link` command with its main/pull guard and the `none` rule, evals. A new 008.03: the linking PR flow, the `run` pre-pass and tsort ordering. (Recommended) b) Three plans: linker plus `link` command / PR flow plus pre-pas…
entries.answer: Decided 2026-10-20 by the product owner: (a) two plans. 008.01: the agent, `Registry#preceding`, executor grants, the `link` command with its main/pull guard and the `[none]` rule, evals. A new 008.03: the linking PR flow (with the narrow auto-merge from A3), the `run` pre-pass and tsort ordering.

entries.text: B6 System lane in the UI The spec says the UI "can add" a dedicated lane for system tasks, where the linking PR would sit until it merges. a) Out of scope here. Note it as a follow-up for 008.02 or the web plans. (Recommended) b) In scope: a front-end unit for `rey-frontend` that adds a "System" lane to the board.
entries.answer: Decided 2026-10-20 by the product owner: (a) out of scope. Note the System lane as a follow-up for 008.02 or the web plans.

It reports 30 failures, all in `spec/openlanes/apps/` and `spec/openlanes/cli/app_spec.rb`, because every TCP connect to 127.0.0.1 succeeds here, even to port 1 with nothing listening (a proxy or network filter on the host), so `Apps::Ports` finds no free port. This plan changes nothing under `apps/`; every other example passes and rubocop is clean. All eight units are built. a) Fix or tu…
entries.answer: b) Accept the 30 apps failures as outside this plan and send it to review as is. Answered by kig on 2026-10-20
